subject.title: [Bug]: Agent self-update bypasses update.run and uses raw npm global upgrade without restarting gateway

question: Should maintainers land the open exec-boundary guard PR for raw global OpenClaw package-manager self-updates, or choose a different enforcement shape?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still rely on prompt guidance plus the safe update.run path, while the missing hard block is a command-execution policy change with compatibility impact for operators who currently allow raw package-manager commands.

options.title: Land exec-boundary guard
options.body: Review and merge the linked PR or an equivalent narrow guard so agents cannot use exec for raw global OpenClaw package-manager self-updates.

options.title: Choose another enforcement layer
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify a different product boundary, such as approval policy or update-command detection outside exec.

options.title: Accept raw exec risk
options.body: Document that trusted agents may run raw package-manager updates and require operators to restart manually, leaving the report unresolved as an accepted risk.

recommendation.title: Land exec-boundary guard
recommendation.body: Review and merge the linked PR or an equivalent narrow guard so agents cannot use exec for raw global OpenClaw package-manager self-updates.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining fix should update the shared exec-control guard boundary where recent verified history points most strongly.
